description: Tulalip Tribes: Saving Their Sacred Salmon is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Tulalip Tribes; Qualco Energy; Snohomish County Public Utility District. People of the Salmon collaborate with farmers to ensure survival of their sacred fish. Coverage: the United States (2015). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
